summary: Approval request: targeted tokenized session snapshot for cross-team privacy validation
description: Request from Privacy Engineering to extract a narrowly-scoped set of customer inference sessions to validate a new strip-and-tokenize redaction algorithm. Purpose is internal verification: confirm PII suppression recall/precision on real traffic patterns before promoting the pipeline to production. This is not a support ticket from a customer; it's an internal compliance validation tied to upcoming SOC readiness work.
request_details: Requested dataset: up to 120 session traces sampled from the last 72 hours matching these filters: (1) route = /v1/chat/stream, (2) response tokens > 512, (3) customer_tier in [dedicated, enterprise], (4) sessions flagged by heuristic 'user_email_detected' or 'credit_card_like_pattern'. Deliverable: tokenized JSONL where original PII is replaced with reversible token IDs for evaluation, plus a parallel masked version for model-quality checks. Access method: time-limited S3 bucket with encryption and presigned GET links; only three named engineers need access.
timebox: Data access window: 48 hours of availability after provisioning. All copies to be deleted or confirmed removed within 7 days. Request expires if not approved by 2026-03-18.
redaction_plan: Redaction will run two passes: (A) automated strip-and-tokenize producing 'token_id' placeholders, retaining token mapping in an HSM-backed vault; (B) a second pass producing a non-reversible masked artifact for broader QA. Vault access restricted to Privacy Eng SRE. We propose storing mapping metadata in a transient, access-audited secrets path and rotating keys after the exercise.
access_provision: Provisioning steps proposed: 1) Create ephemeral S3 prefix s3://redwood-priv-exports/INT-95731/ with bucket policy restricting to requester IAM principals and Security team role. 2) Generate three presigned GET URLs, 48-hour TTL. 3) Create CloudTrail and internal audit log tag 'INT-95731' for all S3 GET/DELETE events. 4) Limit access to corporate IP allowlist and require session MFA.
audit_requirements: All access must be recorded. Create an internal ticket in security-ops to observe the session and confirm no data exfil attempted. Add a post-action entry to the production audit log. Provide cryptographic proof of deletion (S3 object version delete markers and retention confirmation) back to Compliance within 48 hours of deletion.
comments: Aisha Kapoor (2026-03-12): Opening request — Privacy Eng needs a representative sample from prod to validate false-negative cases for the redaction pipeline. Attached heuristic definitions and initial jq filters.

Miles Chen - Privacy Eng (2026-03-12): Clarification: we only need sessions where the model output contained an email-like token or number sequence. We will not request any customer identifiers beyond session IDs. Will use only three engineers: Miles Chen, Priya Rao, and Samir Patel.

Riley Thompson - SRE (2026-03-12): Can provide plan for ephemeral extraction via internal export job; need approval from Security and Compliance to proceed. Concern: ensure no cross-tenant leakage in sampling logic.

Jordan Li - Security (2026-03-13): Security review: acceptable if token mapping is stored in HSM-backed store and access is MFA+IP restricted. Require we attach CloudTrail filters and set S3 bucket with object lock for write-once during the 48h window. Request proof-of-deletion steps be documented.

Priya Rao - Privacy Eng (2026-03-13): Acknowledged Security comments. We'll accept HSM mapping and MFA/IP restrictions. We request a short test export (5 sessions) to validate pipeline before full run.

Riley Thompson - SRE (2026-03-14): Test export completed; artifacts posted to the ephemeral prefix. Privacy Eng confirmed tokenization behaves as expected. Security approved timeboxed full export. Scheduling full job for 2026-03-15 02:00 UTC.
Jordan Li - Security (2026-03-14): Approval granted. Added requirement: Security will observe first two downloads and collect CloudTrail evidence. Marking for closure after deletion confirmation.
Aisha Kapoor (2026-03-14): Noted. Will follow up with Compliance for final signoff and confirm deletion by 2026-03-22.
resolution: Approved and executed. Time-limited artifacts were provisioned to s3://redwood-priv-exports/INT-95731/, accessed by the three named engineers. Security observed downloads; CloudTrail evidence uploaded to secure drive. Mapping table was written to an HSM-backed secrets path and rotated after use. All artifacts were deleted and object delete markers recorded; Compliance confirmed deletion and accepted the cryptographic deletion receipts. Follow-up task INT-96101 opened to automate test-export workflow and integrate deletion receipts into Console audit UI.
notes: Keep this ticket attached to the SOC readiness checklist. Recommend creating a lightweight runbook for future strip-and-tokenize validations to reduce manual approvals.
